sections.heading: Overview
sections.markdown:
# LSIP.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp3,750.0 against Rp1,505.0 (expected total return 155.6%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: commodity_capex_turnaround · method card: per fund record routing for Plantations (palm oil).

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The trapped-cash state is sourced to the 31-Dec-2025 Bank Ina Perdana balance of Rp1,639.556bn (10.55% of total assets), not the 30-Sep-2026 balance. S8 Note 5 shows related-party cash of Rp115.016bn (bank) plus Rp550.00
- The 0.5 persistence probability is unsourced and untested, yet it drives Rp2,508bn of the opening-cash haircut and Rp4,262bn of the retained-cash haircut. The evidence cuts both ways: a 30% dividend paid every year (S12)
- The retained-cash bridge item is computed on the prior engine run (EV Rp24,506.23bn, discount factors at asof 2026-11-08), not the current run (EV Rp24,513.35bn at 2026-11-09), and it deducts FY2026E dividends of Rp566.0

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
